level_rationale: An ocular splash of caustic alkaline lye drain cleaner into the right eye 10 minutes ago is a true ophthalmic emergency requiring immediate emergency department continuous copius irrigation, conjunctival fornix inspection, and serial ocular surface pH measurement to prevent corneal liquefactive necrosis, whereas a splash of clean lukewarm faucet water into the right eye while cleaning a sink is harmless and needs at most home self-care.
